review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent planning expectation for the frozen inputs. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 match the original PRD, including notification-time stop/done boundaries, suppression after settlement, control-symbol exclusion, hook-error handling, and default-pMap-only runtime and type exposure. The complete implementation and declaration evidence supports the exact four-file writable scope; package.json establishes the separate AVA and tsd verification entry points without requiring configuration edits. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent independent TASK-VERIFY match the specification. Their allowed agents have the respective delivery roles, availability, and active project-scoped trusted claims covering the bounded work, including data.change, domain.state, integration.async, integration.consumer, and verifier-only testing.verification; pending security.authorization claims are not needed for this change. A distinct active project reviewer satisfies the supplied earlier high-risk review prerequisite without requiring execution claims. No material unresolved Decision is present in this case, so ready with no blocking reasons is coherent. Repository identity, commit, stable keys, evidence stages, and the release fingerprints agree between Gold and the frozen preview. The source-manifest digest identifies a different described object from the release source digest and is not, by itself, a contradiction. The original specification's remaining-preparation fields describe its earlier preparation state rather than overriding the supplied frozen preview. This review used only the supplied pre-candidate evidence: no code was executed, no human attestation was created, and no Service-calculated digest was independently recomputed.
